draft_en.subject: Active SKUs under the Cleerline label - a second ODM source next to SSF fibre
draft_en.body:
Hi Ryan,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 25 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the media converters and industrial switches sold under the Cleerline label alongside SSF fibre, a second ODM source from small lots, -40 to 75 C, FCC/CE/RoHS: industrial Gigabit converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); PoE version - STI-111GP - $30.1; DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged - STI-280GE - $46. 10G converters and SFPs stay with your current source - we do not carry them.

One question: which active SKU do your integrator dealers reorder most?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
